review.intent_summary: Callers can supply ordered observations or versioned requests whose contracts define datasets, settings, context, and explicit relationships before analysis.

criteria.criterion: Ordered value lists work with separate settings, while schema 1.0 requests describe one dataset.
Schema 1.1 datasets declare a nonempty entity scope and support explicit relationships between named datasets.
Unknown settings, unsupported recipes, nonfinite values, booleans, and numeric strings are rejected.
Published schema 1.0 and 1.1 request and result schemas match the public Python contracts.

verification_evidence: Inspected all four published schema files; passing equality tests compare their complete contents with the corresponding public Python contracts.
Manually checked README.md:279 and README.md:575: both schema versions, required entity scope, and four-dataset/four-relationship limits are documented.
